security_spec.violation_condition: In XiangShan multi-hart RTL within the same supervisor execution environment (SEE), if individual harts report or implement divergent architecturally-visible parameters (e.g., VLEN via vlenb CSR, cache block size via CBO operations, supported extensions via misa, privilege-mode capabilities via menvcfg/senvcfg fields) and the hardware permits thread migration between these harts without architectural-state compatibility enforcement, execution of a migrated thread on a target hart that interprets saved architectural state differently (e.g., truncated vector registers, different PMP granularity, divergent cache-block size affecting CBO.ZERO range) violates the RVA_050 mandate that hart divergences must not interfere with architectural state migration and subsequent correct execution.
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: cross-hart CSR readback divergence: compare vlenb, misa, menvcfg, senvcfg, cboz_block_size, PMP granularity fields across all harts in the same SEE at reset and runtime; flag any mismatch where the thread scheduler or context-switch path does not reject or translate migrated architectural state incompatible with the target hart
security_spec.summary: Multi-hart XiangShan must either enforce identical architecturally-visible parameters across all harts in an SEE (pre-RVA_050 behavior) or implement hardware-visible compatibility gates that prevent migration of architectural state to a hart whose implementation-defined parameters would cause divergent execution of the migrated thread.
